prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 2024年重点信息化项目执行情况汇总表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "项目" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 215px
  col 2: header "负责人" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "预算（万元）" · longest unbreakable word 60px · one-line width 92px
  col 4: header "进度" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 373px
  col 5: header "风险说明" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 1830px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"汇总2024年重点信息化项目的执行情况，便于查看项目责任人、预算、进度及风险。","reading":"读者先按项目定位，再横向核对负责人、预算、进度和风险，也会纵向比较各项目的预算与执行状态。风险说明远长于其他内容，通常决定行高；同一行中其他字段可利用这部分高度换行。360px内容纳五列必须作明显取舍。","groups":["项目与负责人共同标识项目及责任归属，需便于定位和核对。","预算与进度共同呈现执行情况，适合纵向比较。","风险说明与进度相互补充，解释项目执行中的问题。"],"keep_intact":["预算金额及其小数部分","负责人姓名尽量保持完整","项目名称中的专有名称和进度中的关键状态尽量保持可辨认"],"may_wrap":["风险说明可按自然语义换行","较长的项目名称和进度说明可换行","预算表头可在合适位置换行，金额仍需完整"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [69, 56, 81, 53, 100] · table 360×2637px · row heights [83, 571, 455, 455, 478, 594] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 25 lines · mid-word splits 3
Design r0B: widths [58, 51, 81, 49, 120] · table 360×2683px · row heights [83, 571, 548, 501, 478, 501] · column headers wrapped 3/5 · tallest cell 24 lines · mid-word splits 12
Design r0C: widths [80, 59, 81, 60, 79] · table 360×4194px · row heights [83, 920, 711, 734, 780, 966] · column headers wrapped 3/5 · tallest cell 41 lines · mid-word splits 1

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"预算金额完整，项目列大体可辨；风险说明有足够宽度形成短语，比 r0C 更容易阅读。","problems":"负责人姓名和表头换行，进度列呈窄条状，百分数与状态说明被拆开；风险文字仍较密，行内留白分布不均。","cause":"负责人列 56px 扣除内边距后仅余 35px，不足以容纳三个汉字；进度列 53px 仅余 32px，风险列 100px 仅余 79px。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"风险列较宽，说明文字更容易按词组阅读；预算金额保持完整。","problems":"项目名称碎片化，负责人姓名被拆开；进度几乎逐字竖排，UAT 和百分数也被切开，削弱横向核对。虽然风险列更宽，进度列仍使部分行很高。","cause":"项目列 58px、负责人列 51px、进度列 49px 分别仅余 37px、30px、28px 的文本宽度；风险列增加到 120px 挤占了这些列。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"项目名称、负责人及进度比另外两版更容易辨认，预算金额完整，词中断裂最少。","problems":"风险说明被挤成很窄的文字带，造成极长的行和大量其他列的空白，跨行比较困难；风险表头也被拆开。","cause":"风险列 79px 扣除内边距后仅余 58px，而项目、负责人和进度列合计占用 199px，使最长的说明列空间不足。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[65,67,81,53,93],"change":"以 r0A 为基础，将负责人列加宽至可容纳三个汉字，预算宽度保持 81px；项目和风险列各让出少量空间，优先改善姓名及表头的完整性。"},{"name":"progress-first","widths":[62,67,81,64,85],"change":"保持负责人和金额完整，增加进度宽度以减少状态及百分数的拆分；用较窄的风险列换取更清晰的执行状态，检验行高代价。"},{"name":"risk-first","widths":[61,67,81,49,101],"change":"保留完整姓名和金额，将更多空间留给最长的风险说明；通过与 balanced 对照，检验说明的阅读效率能否抵消较窄进度列带来的断行。"}]}
